synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together (mirrored); each block moves alone if its target 4x4 cell is free.
A cell is blocked if it is outside the undrawn playable bound [2,58]^2, an invisible maze cell {(14,38),(6,18),(38,14),(22,18)}, a marker cell or the other block. Step 124 = maze cell (22,18); the bound itself is never hit.
Clicking an inactive marker arms the blocks into players and makes that marker active. Armed A1-A4 move the active marker with the same blocking; clicking another marker switches; clicking a player disarms (stored left position); A5 and other clicks are no-ops.
Hidden action counter a, gated on continuity: bars w=3(a+1)//7; fallback a=0 if no bar else (7w+2)//3. Names = type_color_rank by (y,x), starting at 2 in block mode.
